title: Hugoniot Integration for λ=0.5 Mixture
action: Implement the component equations of state for polyethylene-like and quartz-like materials using the given constants (constant Γ/V, constant C_V, and a cold compression curve), assemble the mixture thermodynamics from the mass-fraction-weighted Gibbs free energy (Gibbs-based mixture relations), and numerically integrate the Hugoniot ordinary differential equation in the pressure-temperature plane for mass fraction λ=0.5 from the initial state (ambient pressure, initial specific volume, 293 K) over a specific volume range covering approximately the initial volume down to 0.25 cc/g. Record the (V, P, T) trajectory points.
description: Core computation: integrating the Hugoniot ODE to obtain mixture equilibrium states.

title: Compute Mixture Properties and Output CSV
action: For each (V,P,T) state from the Hugoniot trajectory, compute: the mixture Grüneisen parameter Γ (from mixture thermodynamics via Γ = αV²/(βV C_P - α²V²T) using mixture derivatives), the sound velocity c, the ratio Γ/V, and the simple mass-weighted-average Grüneisen parameter (Γ_avg = (1-λ)Γ₁ + λΓ₂ using component Γ₁ and Γ₂ obtained from the individual component equations of state). Write a CSV file with columns V, P, T, Gamma_mixture, Gamma_simple_avg, c, Gamma_over_V containing at least 10 points covering the volume range from the initial specific volume down to approximately 0.25 cc/g.
description: Main reproducible artifact: table of Hugoniot states and derived Grüneisen parameters, sound velocity, and Γ/V. The checker verifies structural properties: deviation of the true mixture Γ from the mass-weighted average and the variability of Γ/V.
output_schema: CSV with header: V,P,T,Gamma_mixture,Gamma_simple_avg,c,Gamma_over_V. V in cc/g, P in Mb, T in K, c in km/s, Gamma_over_V in g/cc. All numeric. At least 10 rows.
